_about: Prompts for the cutscene stills in assets/cutscenes/, painted by dev-tools/gen_cutscenes.py through AI Horde. {me} stands for 'protagonist', the same man as the 3D player. First tried on Perchance's generator (Cinematic style), which can't be saved from a script; its style preset is approximated by style_prefix. Kept to what happened, not gore: these are about loneliness and consequence, not shock.
shared_suffix: , gritty 1990s American inner city, dim sodium and fluorescent light, muted desaturated colours with teal shadows, film grain, no text
negative: text, watermark, logo, caption, cartoon, anime, illustration, 3d render, gore, blood, nudity, shirtless, bright, overexposed, text on clothing, lettering, twins, duplicate person

images.intro_mattress: {me} lying awake on a bare stained mattress on the floor of a squalid one-room apartment at dawn, grey light through a bedsheet nailed over the window, empty bottles and clothes on the floor, a bare light bulb
images.intro_sick: close-up of {me}, sweating and pale, sitting on the edge of a mattress hugging himself and shivering, cold grey morning light, cramped dirty room
images.intro_street: {me} seen from behind in a grey hoodie stepping out of a rundown apartment building onto a wet empty city street at morning, boarded windows, liquor store and pharmacy signs down the block, overcast sky
images.busted_cuffs: close-up of steel handcuffs closing on a man's wrists behind his back, a gloved police officer's hands, the sleeve of a grey-green t-shirt, wet sidewalk at night, red and blue police lights reflecting in puddles, shallow depth of field
images.busted_car: view from inside the back seat of a police cruiser at night, {me} handcuffed and slumped against the scratched plexiglass partition, plain unmarked t-shirt, city lights smeared on the rain-streaked window
images.sent_away_court: {me} in an orange jumpsuit standing before a judge's bench in a shabby fluorescent-lit courtroom, seen from behind, a public defender beside him
images.sent_away_bus: {me} in an orange jumpsuit sitting alone in a prison transport bus, looking out of a barred window at a grey city passing by, overcast daylight
images.overdose_fade: blurred dreamlike view of a squalid apartment ceiling and a bare light bulb, warm hazy glow, tilted dutch angle, soft focus, drifting out of consciousness
images.overdose_floor: an empty dark apartment at night seen from the doorway, a figure lying still on the floor beside a mattress, a single bare light bulb, long shadows, silent and lonely
images.overdose_lights: blue and red emergency lights flickering across the ceiling and wall of a dark apartment stairwell at night, a paramedic stretcher at the top of the stairs, no faces visible
images.first_score_corner: {me} facing a heavyset bearded dark-haired dealer in a black hooded jacket with the hood up, under a flickering streetlight at the dark end of a city block at night, the dealer glancing up the street, their hands low between them
images.first_score_walk: {me} walking fast away down a wet night sidewalk with his hands deep in his pockets and his head down, neon shop signs blurred behind him
images.released_door: a steel holding cell door sliding open onto a harsh fluorescent police station corridor, {me} sitting on a bench inside squinting at the light
images.released_steps: {me} walking down the concrete steps of a police station at dawn, squinting against the pale sky, alone, a cold empty street ahead
images.new_day: dawn light through a bedsheet nailed over a window of a squalid apartment, a crumpled mattress, an overflowing ashtray and a walkman with headphones on the floor, quiet and grey
images.recovered_clinic: {me} at a small clinic window in the early morning, a nurse handing him a tiny paper cup through the hatch, a line of tired people behind him, pale morning light
images.recovered_window: {me} pulling a bedsheet down from a window in a tidied one-room apartment, warm morning sunlight flooding in across a made mattress, dust in the light
images.recovered_street: {me} walking down a sunlit city sidewalk in the morning with a paper cup of coffee and walkman headphones around his neck, a faint tired smile, people going to work around him
